findings.description: server-in-the-loop's Modes bullet was no noun or gerund phrase, failing test_modes.
Two caller lines read as other actions once their link became a plain title (Index Status, Merge Base).
Commands sat after their result handling in delivery-branches.md.
Command bodies ran in another order than their caller line named them in pull-request.md.
A step sentence read "invokes Apply [Validate Lane Unit]".
A command in an entry point under a heading carrying a numbered list escaped the check.
A call link to a step's own command passed unreported.
A step writing several commands needed only one input and one output link in all.
A flush GraphQL block in a list-model sub-procedure skipped the REST-gap check.
The uncited rule claimed every structure while the check reads declared ones.
The vendored exclusion matched a folder name, so naming a gitnexus skill directly checked it.
Numbered detail after an operation's command made it a procedure.
Tests lacked the uncited clearing paths and the new checks.
test_board_status called the check without citations.
The shared Commands rules still gave every command a sub-section and stated no title rule.
loop-mode steps lacked their bold labels.
Moved result lines lost the conditions they sat under in delivery-branches.md.
